answer.summary: Identify a peer-reviewed study measuring coherence decay in agent outputs under intermittent input with bounded token budgets and known perturbations using time-series linguistic embedding models.
answer.content: Search for a single, measurable output metric such as coherence decay from a peer-reviewed study on tokenized agent outputs under intermittent input with bounded token budgets and known perturbations, using time-series linguistic embedding models. The study must report explicit per-interval coherence metrics and decay rate under controlled conditions to validate the research question with empirical grounding.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to extract coherence decay metrics and per-interval drift scores from the identified study
answer.lesson: All research questions involving agent memory must be anchored in a single, verifiable metric from peer-reviewed studies before comparative analysis can proceed; avoid multi-dimensional, ungrounded inquiries in early phases.'
